question: Client assets per advisor across the five -- and is that comparison even valid?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James states that financial advisors associated with firms in its RCS division are not included in its financial advisor counts, although their client assets are included in its AUA.
items.quote: Financial advisors associated with firms in RCS are not included in our financial advisor counts, although their client assets are included in our AUA.

items.text: Raymond James states that advisors in its RCS division are not included in its financial advisor metric although their client assets are included in PCG AUA.
items.quote: Advisors in our RCS division are not included in our financial advisor metric although their client assets are included in PCG AUA.

items.text: Raymond James reports its financial advisors split between employee financial advisors and independent contractor financial advisors (total advisors 8,943 as of September 30, 2025).
Raymond James reports having approximately 19,500 associates (including 3,878 employee financial advisors) and 5,065 independent advisors as of September 30, 2025.
items.quote: we had approximately 19,500 associates (including 3,878 employee financial advisors) and 5,065 independent advisors

items.text: Raymond James describes independent contractor financial advisors as generally responsible for all their direct costs and receiving a higher payout percentage than employee financial advisors.
items.quote: Our financial advisors who are independent contractors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors.

items.text: Raymond James reports total client assets under administration in its PCG segment of $1.67 trillion as of September 30, 2025, of which $1.01 trillion related to fee-based accounts, with 8,943 employee and independent contractor financial advisors.
items.quote: Total client assets under administration (“AUA”) in our PCG segment as of September 30, 2025 were $1.67 trillion, of which $1.01 trillion related to fee-based accounts... We had 8,943 employee and independent contractor financial advisors

items.text: Raymond James reports AUA associated with firms in its RCS division totaled $217.3 billion as of September 30, 2025, and notes RCS advisor client assets are included in AUA but the advisors themselves are not in advisor counts.
items.quote: AUA associated with firms in our RCS division totaled $217.3 billion as of September 30, 2025.

items.text: Raymond James reports domestic PCG assets under administration split across Employee, Independent contractor, and RIA & Custody Services (RCS) channels, showing RCS of $186 billion as of March 31, 2020 and $696 billion as of March 31, 2025.
items.quote: DOMESTIC PCG ASSETS UNDER ADMINISTRATION ... 186 ... 696 ... Employee Independent contractor RIA & Custody Services (RCS)

items.text: Raymond James reports financial advisor counts of 8,011 employees and 8,787 independent contractors (its affiliation options) with a 2% five-year CAGR.
items.quote: FINANCIAL ADVISORS ... 8,011 ... 8,787 ... Employees Independent Contractors ... 2% 5-Yr CAGR

cells.reason: The passages state how Raymond James defines and reports its advisor count (employee vs. independent contractor, excluding RCS advisors) and client asset measures (AUA including RCS assets), which is directly relevant to whether a client-assets-per-advisor comparison across firms is valid.
